features.t: Parameters (create, read, update, delete, history, labels, tags)
Documents (create, update, versions, default version, delete)

x: Vyomi has no real SSM Agent or managed-instance fleet behind Run Command: every instance ID you target completes immediately as Success with no real command output, the same shape Run Command reports for an instance it can't actually reach.
An association's status never advances past "Pending"/"Creating" — Vyomi has no agent to run the document on a schedule and report compliance back.

features.t: Maintenance windows (create, update, enable/disable, targets, delete)
Patch baselines (create, approval rules, approved/rejected patches, delete)
x: Approval rules and approved/rejected patches are stored and returned exactly as configured, but never evaluated against real instance patch compliance — there is no patch scan/install behind a baseline.

Offline, running Docker instances register as Online managed nodes (DescribeInstanceInformation) and sessions open a command-at-a-time shell in the instance container. The ssmmessages data-channel websocket is not served, so the AWS CLI session-manager-plugin cannot attach; use the console session or ssh. Nano (v4): a running in-browser EC2 VM (nano_vm_compute on) registers as an Online managed node in the console's page and sessions run a command-at-a-time shell in that v86 Alpine VM (the console Connect > Session Manager tab); an instance without a running VM, or the SDK/CLI relay worker (which has no VM host), answers TargetNotConnected. No ssmmessages data channel, so the CLI session-manager-plugin cannot attach.
